NYS PHYSICAL EDUCATION LEARNING STANDARDS (2020) IMPLEMENTATION ROADMAP 
Phase I: Raise Awareness 
• 
Make all education stakeholders aware of the NYS Physical 
Education Learning Standards (2020) and the rollout timeline for 
implementation; highlight areas of impact with respect to current 
standards, instruction, and assessment. This statewide 
collaborative phase with BOCES, school districts, and higher 
education will help identify the necessary professional 
development that will occur in Phase II.
